title: Visual state for lines: not learned / words known / line learned
description: Show different visual states for each line: (1) not learned, (2) some words known from other songs, (3) line explicitly marked as learned.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Words known state: subtle indicator (e.g., partial border or icon)
Line learned state: green checkmark + subtle green tint
States fetched efficiently (batch query for all lines)
Verify in browser: all three states render correctly
